findings.title: Reader thread not joined before asserting; test can pass despite failures
findings.body:
The test sets `deletedAll` and asserts on `caughtExceptions` right away, without joining the reader thread. Exceptions from an in-flight request can arrive after the assertion, so the test can miss failures.

The reader may also not have started or completed a single request before the deletes finish, so the race may never be exercised. If a delete throws, `deletedAll` is never set and the thread loops forever. Keep a handle to the thread, set the flag in a finally block, and join the thread before asserting.

findings.title: Other subgroup methods still NPE when group deleted concurrently
findings.body: `getSubGroupsCount` now null-checks `modelSupplier.get()`. The three `getSubGroupsStream` overloads at lines 256, 262 and 268 still dereference `modelSupplier.get()` directly. A group removed concurrently can therefore still cause the same NPE through those paths.
